cost: sort O(n log n)/O(n) extra; filter O(n), out O(log n); codecs O(n), <=10 bytes/u64; zstd19 data-dependent. Whole-column decompression/count allocation have no cap.
description: Parallel edge columns, tuple sorting, all-bit subgraphs, outgoing ranges, and delta/zigzag/byte-plane zstd persistence.
forward: push appends aligned six-tuples. sort applies an unstable permutation by(src,rel,dst); filter retains i iff flags[i]&mask=mask; out(s)=partition_point(<s)..partition_point(<=s). write encodes wrapping src deltas, signed zigzag wrapping dst deltas, u32 byte planes, compresses six files then writes count.
inverse: Sorted result admits original permutations and equal-key rearrangements. Filter admits arbitrary rejected-row interleavings. Encoder stream plus count determines vectors, decoder preimages include trailing LEB bytes. Empty result may mean empty input or all filtered.
limitations: No crash/allocation/zstd-fuzz/oversized graph execution; no approximate identifier/codec semantics.
Partial lexical AST; no semantic proof or useful executable percentage surrogate.
